highlights.title: Bigg Boss 8

highlights.desc:
As the excitement builds, speculation about the contestants has also been rife. The Instagram page Telugu Bigg Boss Stars, known for its reliable updates, has revealed the first set of confirmed contestants. Among those entering the Bigg Boss house this season are:
1. Indraneel Varma
2. Shanoor Sana
3. Tejaswini Gowda
4. Ravi Teja
5. Rithu Chowdary
6. Comedian Babloo
7. Vishnupriya
8. Pavitra
9. Anjali Pawan
highlights.title: Bigg Boss Telugu 8 confirmed contestants list:

highlights.desc:
Bigg Boss stands as a renowned reality show on Indian television. The eagerly awaited Telugu edition, Season 8 of Bigg Boss, is set to commence on 1st September 2024. Hosted by the esteemed King Nagarjuna, the house will welcome 19 contestants.

Below, we present the comprehensive list and details of the participants in Bigg Boss Telugu Season 8.

highlights.desc: Your Sunday plans with Nagarjuna 👑💪🏻
highlights.title: Bigg Boss 8 Streaming 1st September from 7pm!

highlights.desc: 3 Days to go…
highlights.title: The biggest show coming right back!

highlights.desc: Get ready as King Nagarjuna returns in a grand style to unveil the contestants of an electrifying new season, packed with limitless drama and entertainment. Watch Now
highlights.title: Season Premiere | S8 - E1

highlights.desc: An array of arguments ensues as the contestants enter the house. Later, the housemates' physical strength is put to test to grab the spot of the third chief. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 1: A Task for the Third Chief | S8 - E2

highlights.desc: After a midnight altercation, the house meets in the morning to discuss tasks. Later, housemates clash with the chiefs during the season’s first nomination. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 2: Nomination Sparks Fiery Fights

highlights.desc: Tension rises as the housemates engage in verbal war to nominate each other. Subsequently, BB summons Manikanta to the confession room. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 3: Confession Room's First Visitor

highlights.desc: Stronger the clan, powerful the chief! The three chiefs must choose a team for themselves, not only by convincing the housemates but also by performing a task. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 4: Chiefs to Select Their Clan

highlights.desc: Yashmi and Nainika’s clans battle through tasks for the opportunity to steal a member from Nikhil’s team. However, a surprise from BB leaves the winners in awe. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 5: Clash of Clans

highlights.desc: Excitement fills the air as Nagarjuna joins the housemates for Vinayaka Chavithi. Later, things become intense when he dives into individual performance reviews. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 6: King Meets the Housemates

highlights.desc: It is that time of the week when the housemates have to take names for eviction. A verbal war begins as they pour the paint on the ones they nominate. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 7: First Eviction

highlights.desc: It is that time of the week when the housemates have to take names for eviction. A verbal war begins as they pour the paint on the ones they nominate. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 8: A Colourful Nomination

highlights.desc: Nomination spirals into personal attacks and painful disputes, leaving Nainika in tears. The drama intensifies as BB orders housemates to surrender all their ration. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 9: Food Lockdown?

highlights.desc: The chiefs get a chance to shop for groceries, while their clans fight to defend the respective provisions. During the task, Sanchalak Yashmi faces pushback over her strict rules. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 10: Find and Run

highlights.desc: BB provides a bunch of opportunities for the housemates to win their budget. Each of the clans puts up a tough fight, but the Sanchalak's decision leads to chaos. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 11: A Battle for the Budget

highlights.desc: After Prerana's decision on the Socks task, the house engages in an energetic Truth or Dare game. The lively mood shifts to an emotional tone with an unexpected surprise from BB. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 12: Special Gifts for the Housemates

highlights.desc: Nagarjuna assesses the chiefs and clans with a mix of praise and critique. Further, he brightens Shekar's day with good news while delivering a shocker to the chiefs. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 13: Shocks and A Surprise

highlights.desc: Sunday Funday begins with electing new chiefs and members, followed by Nagarjuna's energetic games. The drama heightens as he drops a new twist in this week's eviction. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 14: Elect Chiefs, Evict a Member

highlights.desc: Clans Kantara and Shakti delegate tasks and discuss last week's robbery. Yet another series of verbal war ensues as the nominations with dust showers begin. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 15: Dusty Nominations and Drama

highlights.desc: After going over the nominations, housemates challenge each other for this week's provisions. Which clan will grab the most points from the three intense tasks? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 16: Clans Kantara vs Shakti

highlights.desc: Disputes arise over Sonia's decision on the balloon task. The next day, the chiefs tackle a new task while Prabhavathi 2.0 returns to the house to present a special assignment. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 17: Prabhavathi Is Back!

highlights.desc: The housemates compete fiercely to collect the maximum eggs. As the clans face a cooking restriction, the losing team is forced to eliminate one member. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 18: Procure Eggs to Prevail

highlights.desc: With the red egg, clan Shakti wins the advantage to choose one member for chief contendership. On the other hand, BB shows the main door to clan Kantara for disobeying the rules. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 19: Who Will be the Next Chief?

highlights.desc: Nagarjuna confronts the housemates about their misbehaviour. He calls out everyone's faults and, in a dramatic twist, shows a red card to Abhai for his reckless comments. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 20: Season's First Red Card

highlights.desc: Nagarjuna ignites a wave of laughter this weekend with quirky games that keep the housemates on edge. As the thrill escalates, one contestant gets ready to exit. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 21: Playtime with the King

highlights.desc: As housemates reminisce about their time with the evictee, they gear up for this week's nominations. With emotions flaring over past disputes, how will the process play out? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 22: Nomination in Full Swing!

highlights.desc: With emotions still high from the nominations, Yashmi and Sonia get into a brawl. Later, Nikhil competes with the housemates for a chance to choose clan Kantara's next chief. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 23: Welcome, New Chief

highlights.desc: Seetha takes charge of her new Kantara clan. Soon after, the house descends into chaos when BB reveals the potential arrival of 12 wildcards. What challenges await the housemates? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 24: A Bigg Twist

highlights.desc: Shakti clan wins the thrilling third task of 'Survival of the Fittest', and gains the power to eliminate a Kantara member. Manikanta revolts, sparking arguments within his clan. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 25: Clan Shakti in Turmoil

highlights.desc: BB shares the perks of a golden band, which a member of the Shakti clan puts to work. Later, laughter echoes through the house as everyone engages in mimicry for the next task. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 26: Imitation Game

highlights.desc: Past conflicts resurface when Nagarjuna asks the housemates to classify each other as 'heroes' and 'zeroes.' One faces the danger zone, while another is saved from eviction. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 27: A Crowning Ceremony

highlights.desc: Nagarjuna hosts an exciting day filled with engaging games that keep the housemates fully entertained. However, he shocks them by granting the power to save or evict a nominee. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 28: Housemates Take a Call

highlights.desc: The housemates present their nominations by throwing the pictures on fire, sparking arguments. Simultaneously, they are asked to vote for the chief among Seetha and Nikhil. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 29: Nominations of Fire

highlights.desc: Survival of the Fittest series continues, and both the clans put up a tough fight in the challenges. As clan Shakti outperforms, clan Kantara is compelled to remove two members. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 30: Clan Shakti's Winning Streak

highlights.desc: Clan Shakti secures victory and selects a chief contender to block the wildcards. Emotional disputes surface when BB allows others to compete for the position. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 31: Pick Your Next Chief

highlights.desc: BB dissolves the clans and hosts a task for the contenders to become Mega Chief. As one of them takes charge, an unexpected midweek eviction leaves everyone shell-shocked. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 32: Midweek Eviction

highlights.desc: Manikanta's amusing predictions as an astrologer earn applause in the house. A cloud of tension looms later when they face tough choices and special gifts in the confession room. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 33: A Token of Love

highlights.desc:
Season 1 - Hariteja
Season 3 - Rohini
Season 4 - Avinash , Gangavva and Mehaboob
Season 7 - Gautham , Nayani and Tasty Teja
highlights.title: Bigg Boss 8 Wild card entries list

highlights.desc: One more housemate bids goodbye. Tables turn as the King welcomes the wildcard entrants and splits all the housemates into two new clans. What surprises are about to be unveiled? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 35: The Grand Reload Event

highlights.desc: A wave of excitement fills the house as OG clan welcomes the wildcards aka the Royal clan. However, their happiness is short-lived as nominations from the newbies stun everyone. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 36: New Housemates, New Drama

highlights.desc: Royal Clan reaps benefits during nominations, putting others in a tough spot. Chaos ensues in the house after mega chief Nabeel slips up during his trip to the supermarket. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 37: Mega Chief's Plea to BB

highlights.desc: Avinash takes charge of the ladies, while Rohini coaches the boys in a hilarious challenge. Later, the OG clan excitedly rolls out the red carpet for the Royals to their new Hotel. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 38: Welcome to BB Hotel

highlights.desc: Staff swap roles and impress the guests for rewards, but a new physical challenge complicates matters. As time runs out and prize money increases, which clan will claim victory? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 39: Staff vs the Guests

highlights.desc: Six members of Royal clan face off against one member from OG to become the next Mega Chief. However, the tasks go awry as contenders engage in personal conflicts. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 40: Royals Fight for Leadership

highlights.desc: Nagarjuna confronts the BB Hotel drama while handing out penalties and advice. As the royals' gameplay faces intense scrutiny, the stakes for eviction predictions rise. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 41: A Spotlight on Royal Clan

highlights.desc: Amidst the daily tiffs, BB kicks off the nominations for this week. Killer girls Hari Teja and Prerna get to approve the housemates' choices, ensuing intense confrontations. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 43: Killer Girls Get to Choose

highlights.desc: Nominations go astray when housemates and nominees engage in hateful verbal wars. Adding to the chaos, BB grants the Royal clan a special power which flips the game. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 44: The Game-Changer

highlights.desc: Nabeel's selfless wish and a hilarious skit brings rewards to the kitchen. Gangavva becomes a contender, while the rest fight for a chance through the Battery task. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 45: Brawls Over Battery

highlights.desc: Royals take out one opponent and desperately try to gain battery in exchange for facilities. Although the OGs resist the temptation, an internal argument throws them into panic. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 46: High Voltage Drama

highlights.desc: Royal clan wins the pillow challenge. Avinash and Prithvi get the opportunity to earn additional prize money but at a cost. Finally, who will take over as the Mega Chief? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 47: Final Fight for Mega Chief

highlights.desc: Nagarjuna talks about the past week's happenings and later initiates an intriguing BB Times task. Meanwhile, Prithvi gets an exclusive yet challenging offer. Will he accept it? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 48: Its Time for 'BB Times'

highlights.desc: The atmosphere buzzes with excitement as Nagarjuna entertains the housemates with interesting games. As the fun unfolds, one housemate gets ready to exit the house. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 49: Games Galore

highlights.desc: During the pot-breaking nomination process, tensions flare between Prithvi and Rohini. Later, mega chief Gowtham uses a shield to protect a housemate, leaving Prerana disappointed. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 50: Midway through the Race

highlights.desc: Prithvi and Vishnupriya top the list of nominations. Concerned, the OGs urge Prithvi to reconsider his gameplay, while mega chief Gowtham gets the privilege to save a nominee. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 51: Pot-breaking Nominations

highlights.desc: A spontaneous gym session and a spooky prank by the Royals lift everyone's spirits. The next day, housemates gear up to decide who's in the running to become the mega chief. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 52: Royals' Shenanigans

highlights.desc: OG clan wins over the Royals and choose Prithvi and Nikhil as contenders for the Chief. OGs also claim that the title winner of S8 will be one among them. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 53: OG Clan Turns the Table

highlights.desc: As BB introduces tougher tasks with clever twists, more contenders enter the race and disagreements arise within the clans. Who will be declared as next week's mega chief? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 54: Meet Your New Mega Chief

highlights.desc: Nagarjuna commends Gangavva for her prank and addresses last week's conflicts with the housemates. Later, the excitement peaks when actor Suriya join him for a lively evening. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 55: Funday with Suriya

highlights.desc: The festivities begin with heartwarming surprises and fun games for the housemates. To add to the excitement, Nagarjuna invites celebrities on stage before eviction. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 56: Diwali Dhamaka

highlights.desc: Avinash's sudden exit shocks all, while BB's decision to let mega chief Vishnupriya imprison five nominees heightens the drama. Hurt by her picks, OGs seek redemption in round two. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 57: It's Jail Time for Nominees

highlights.desc: The OG and Royal clans merge and together compete for the Mega Chief contendership. Four teams of three battle to secure at least one top position, leading to chaos. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 58: The Mega Clan

highlights.desc: The water tank task continues and so do the intense fights. Team Green wins and gets to roll the dice, while teams Blue and Red manage to win the next two tasks. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 59: Team Yellow Lags Behind

highlights.desc: To earn extra cooking time, Rohini and Avinash get a task of turning into toddlers. As the challenges for the Mega Chief gets tougher, who will finally win the title this week? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 60: Emotional Outbursts

highlights.desc: Festive excitement fills the air as housemates enjoy Diwali with a special pooja and lively competitions. Mega chief Avinash makes a request, while BB surprises them all. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 61: Happy Diwali!

highlights.desc: King applauds Avinash for his fun penalties directed at the midday sleepyheads. He also praises the teams for their task performance while reinforcing the importance of decorum. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 62: Nagarjuna's Message to the House

highlights.desc: The evening turns exhilarating as Nagarjuna engages housemates with quirky guessing games. Later, he hosts a juice mixing challenge ahead of the eviction. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 63: Non-Stop Fun with the King

highlights.desc: The week kicks off with heightened emotions as housemates face nominations. Past conflicts resurface, and mega chief Avinash steps in to save a nominee. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 64: Nomination Frenzy

highlights.desc: Nabeel, Prithvi and Rohini unexpectedly win the contendership for Mega Chief. Their next challenge is to retain this victory by battling the tough tasks designed for them. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 65: Contendership Up For Grabs

highlights.desc: Contenders Vishnupriya, Prerana and Yashmi confront each other in a strenuous task to grab the spot. Later, BB gives an interesting dare to Prerana and Tasty Teja. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 66: Spill the Tea

highlights.desc: A prank leaves chief contender Yashmi on edge, while Prithvi's actions make Vishnupriya question their bond. In the final round, housemates jeopardise Nabeel's chance to win. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 67: Chaos Over Contendership

highlights.desc: Prerana is crowned as the new mega chief, leaving Rohini upset. Later, BB gives housemates a chance to earn an eviction shield by nominating those they deem unworthy. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 68: Eviction Shield

highlights.desc: Rule violation and poor performance land Tasty Teja in trouble, while Nagarjuna gives the contenders a chance to win the shield. Unfortunate results await one of the housemates. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 69: Nagarjuna's Verdict

highlights.desc: Nagarjuna looks into the food theft, while the housemates entertain him with a playful cosplay game. Later, Varun Tej joins them ahead of this week's elimination. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 70: Cosplay Fun and Food Theft

highlights.desc: Reeling from last week's drama, housemates face nominations where they paint criticisms on each other's portraits. Tasty Teja and Gowtham get defensive, which sparks heated tiffs. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 71: Nomination Fall Out

highlights.desc: The most awaited days are finally here! Nabeel and Rohini welcome their dear ones to the house. On the other hand, Tasty Teja makes a tearful plea to BB. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 72: Family Week

highlights.desc: Yashmi and Nikhil's happiness knows no bounds as their parents enter the house and join them in various tasks. Avinash reunites with his wife, but faces a very crucial choice. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 73: A Sweet Surprise for Avinash

highlights.desc: Excitement fills the air when Vishnupriya and Prithvi reunite with their loved ones. Adding to it, Gotham's brother visits him, while Prerana receives a sweet virtual surprise. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 74: Happy Reunions

highlights.desc: Family week ends on a high note as Prerana and Tasty Teja receive heartwarming surprises. Later, the housemates gear up to choose their next mega chief. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 75: Unexpected Arrivals, Unlimited Joy

highlights.desc: Nagarjuna interacts with the housemates and recalls their memorable moments from the week. Later, he welcomes celebrities and family members to join him on stage. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 76: Limitless Fun with the Guests

highlights.desc: Housemates' loved ones continue to visit, and Nagarjuna keeps them engaged with games. Tension builds as Nabeel faces the crucial decision of whether to use his eviction shield. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 77: A Game-Changing Choice

highlights.desc: As part of a nomination twist, Sonia, Shekar, and Bebakka enter to the house to nominate two housemates. During the defense, tempers flare and clashes erupt between them. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 78: Evictees' Comeback!

highlights.desc: Nominations by Aditya, Nainika, Manikanta and Seetha bring hidden issues to light, leaving the housemates bitter and upset. Will these issues tear apart their bonds? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 79: Housemates in a Fix

highlights.desc: Housemates reflect on the nominations, after which a prank leaves Tasty Teja clueless. Later, chaos ensues as they battle to protect their t-shirts to secure a spot as a contender. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 80: One Last Battle to Become Contender

highlights.desc: Nikhil and Rohini compete for a spot, but Gotham's accusation against the OG clan sparks arguments. After the contenders face a gruelling task, Vishwak Sen makes a surprise entry. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 81: Vishwak Sen Visits the House

highlights.desc: The contenders face intense tasks to become the season's final Mega Chief. Amidst this, an argument between Rohini and Vishnupriya adds to the drama. Who will claim the title? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 82: Season's Last Mega Chief

highlights.desc: Rohini and Vishnupriya are reprimanded for their actions, while Gowtham and Prithvi receive a warning. Later, a game of Snakes and Ladders leaves Nikhil and Gowtham with a twist. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 83: A Stern Warning from the King

highlights.desc: Nagarjuna enjoys the housemates' fun guessing game and their witty complaints. However, all eyes soon shift to Yashmi and Prithvi, who anxiously await their fate. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 84: Eviction Day

highlights.desc: BB asks the housemates to nominate those who don't deserve to be in the grand finale. As each one steps forward for the activity, heated arguments take over the house. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 85: Paint it Red!

highlights.desc: Former contestants Akhil and Harika kickstart the Ticket to Finale battle. They must choose the contenders for the first task and present a black badge to the loser. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 86: The TTF Race Begins

highlights.desc: Priyanka and Manas enter the house to plan round two and finalise yet another contender for the TTF race. Who will grab the next spot, and who will get the black star? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 87: Strength, Strategy Put to Test

highlights.desc: The hunt to pick the next contender resumes when Punarnavi and Vithika enter. Nikhil takes the lead, while some housemates raise voices against the unjust decisions. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 88: May the Strongest One Win

highlights.desc: Nikhil, Rohini, and Avinash pick Teja as the fourth contender. Later, Sreemukhi enters the house to unfold a few twists. Finally, who will win the Ticket to Finale? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 89: Ticket To Finale Goes to...

highlights.desc: Avinash makes it to the finals, but Nagarjuna's Ticket game sparks tension. In addition, a shocking double eviction twist leaves the housemates on edge. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 90: Double Eviction

highlights.desc: Nagarjuna brings in a set of hilarious and entertaining games for the housemates. Tension rises for yet another eviction of this week. Who will bid goodbye? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 91: One Left, Who's Next?

highlights.desc: Nominations leave everyone at risk except Avinash. Nikhil and Gowtham lock horns during the task, while Nabeel and Prerana get a golden opportunity, but it comes at a price. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 92: A Battle for the Second Spot

highlights.desc: Housemates get one chance to appeal for votes, leading to a heated argument between Nabeel and Rohini. Shekhar Master's surprise visit brings added excitement with a fun twist. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 93: Vote Appeal

highlights.desc: Chaos erupts as Prerana contests Nabeel's win for a chance to appeal for votes. Later, the Vah-Chef makes a surprise entry into the house and prepares a delicious feast. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 94: Task Decision Sparks Unrest

highlights.desc: Avinash's sacrifice helps Rohini take the lead, while Vishnupriya wins the second round. Now, it's up to the rest of the housemates to pick one of them. Who will that be? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 95: Who Will Secure the Next Spot?

highlights.desc: Nikhil and Gotham face off for a chance to appeal, but the former's sharp remarks lead to a major clash. Later, Ohmkar makes a surprise visit to the house. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 96: Verbal War

highlights.desc: Nagarjuna delves into the housemates' regrets from their journey so far. He then shocks everyone with a Double Elimination announcement, leaving the housemates on edge. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 97: Eviction Shocker

highlights.desc: Housemates discuss their plans for the prize money. After exciting tasks and reveals, Nagarjuna announces the finalists, while the remaining one faces eviction. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 98: Meet the Finalists

highlights.desc: To increase the prize money, the finalists take on quirky tasks. The excitement doubles as Maa stars joins them, bringing chaos, laughter and nonstop entertainment to the house. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 99: Maa vs BB Parivaaram

highlights.desc: Kavya, Ganga and Gangadhar from Maa Parivaar light up the house with their fun-filled entry. Later, they take on thrilling challenges with the finalists to boost the prize money. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 100: Bigg Wins

highlights.desc: The housemates prepare some tasty treats for Bigg Boss, and BB returns the favour with delicious delights. Later, Maa Parivaram stars Vaishanavi and Krishna enter the house. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 101: A Fun Banter with BB

highlights.desc: With just a few days left for the finale, BB prepares some special treats for the finalists. Today, Gautham and Avinash get a chance to relive their incredible journey in S8. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 102: A Trip Down the Memory Lane

highlights.desc: Nikhil, Nabeel and Prerna get to go through and celebrate their amazing journeys of this season. BB motivates them and wishes goodluck for the finale. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 103: Reliving the Season

highlights.desc: With just one day for the grand finale, the housemates share the best and worst memories of their life with BB. Later, ever gracious Suma enters to entertain the finalists. Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 104: And the Countdown Begins!

highlights.desc: After 14 weeks of limitless drama and entertainment, Nagarjuna sets the stage for the epic finale. Who will seize the dream trophy and become the winner? Watch Now
highlights.title: Day 105: Grand Finale
